headline: Binance in Talks for Malaysia Licence After Five-Year Absence
summary: Binance is in discussions to secure a licence in Malaysia after being forced to halt operations five years ago for operating an unregistered digital asset exchange.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume; re-entering regulated jurisdictions is key to its international compliance strategy.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Securing a licence in Malaysia would reopen an important Southeast Asian market for the exchange.
